'''2016 Worlds Day 2 Mike Richards DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2016 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125623/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-world-championships.html Internet Archive]
